headline: Quarter shows uneven revenue growth with AI driving strong gains for a few firms.
summary: Overall IT services revenue grew modestly, led by high‑growth players like Coforge and LTM. AI‑related deals contributed to profit acceleration at HCLTech and Infosys, but margin pressure persisted at Wipro. Guidance ranges from flat to low double‑digit growth, indicating a cautious outlook.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: Several firms cite AI‑led pipelines and revenue contributions, boosting profit margins and deal wins.

themes.title: Revenue growth divergence
themes.detail: Coforge posted >50% YoY growth, while Infosys and Wipro saw single‑digit increases.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
13.6% YoY revenue growth and strong AI‑led managed services deals.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY, prompting a cut in FY27 guidance.
